# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Clerk and sailor  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Dick was a big, handsome fellow with dashing ways. He had high color, light-colored hair, and a distinct Moore family feature: one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick possessed a small, ugly, and selfish soul, always wanting something until he obtained it and then ceasing to care for it. He was generally agreeable when things went his way, but he possessed a sea-going streak, drank heavily, and was prone to becoming restless in quiet situations.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)_

## Traits

- Selfish  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Restless  <sub>[v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- Drunkard  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c30 P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)</sub>

## Abilities

- Sailing  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- Marry Leslie West  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## History

Dick Moore grew up at the Glen, where his father Abner kept a store. He became enamored with Leslie West, who repeatedly snubbed him, but he eventually coerced her into marriage with her mother's aid. After living with Leslie at the West place for a winter, he grew restless and went to Nova Scotia. From there, he joined his cousin George Moore on a voyage to Havana aboard the vessel Four Sisters. While in Cuba, Dick died of yellow fever thirteen years before his death became known to his community. For twelve years, his family and neighbors back at Four Winds mistook his injured and amnesiac cousin, George Moore, for Dick himself.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c33 P9](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0009)_

- Son of Abner Moore  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
